text:
Tess: Quick sync  VoltEdge marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for images, offer metadata, legal text, and a staging publish window. Can PartnerOps confirm whats already staged?
Arjun: I can own the manifest + infra hooks. Will need TF outputs: `publisher_account_id`, `listing_bucket`, `kms_key_arn`, `delegated_admin`. Example snippet I expect:
```
publisher_account_id = \"111222333444\"
listing_bucket = \"redwood-marketplace-staging\"
kms_key_arn = \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd1234\"
```
PartnerOps: Staging creds live in 1Password `marketplace-voltedge`. Uploaded AMI `ami-0a9b8c7d`, GCP image `voltedge-stg-2026-07-05`, Azure VHD `voltedge-stg.vhd`. Links + checksums posted.
Maya: Legal needs EULA redline, DPA summary, export-control statement, and a one-liner privacy blurb for the listing. Telemetry default 30 days, aggregated only, opt-out available.
Tess: Assets: SVG + 1200x600 PNG, 3 screenshots, short blurb <=240 chars, long blurb <=1200 chars, docs URL, marketing contact. Regions: US/EU/APAC.
Arjun: For Azure we also need tenant id and an ARM snippet. For GCP provide an importable image tarball or `gcloud compute images create` command.
PartnerOps: Posted ARM snippet and GCP import command in 1Password. Also opened support tickets with AWS/Azure to pre-warm entitlements.
Maya: Telemetry clause for manifest: "Aggregated non-PII usage retained 30 days; customers may opt out via account settings; no PII exported." I'll post redlines by EOD.
Tess: Pricing call  14-day trial + per-seat metered recommended. Any objections?
Arjun: No objections. Add `recommended_instance` field (e.g., `g5.xlarge`) but dont pin instance families. Include `min_vcpu`.
PartnerOps: Offer metadata proposed: offerId `redwood-voltedge-01`, publisher display `Redwood Inference`, sku `voltedge-trial-v1`. Posting to vault now.
MarketplaceBot: Preflight job scheduled: preflight-2755551234 (checks: images, manifest shape, legal artifacts) ETA 2026-07-10 09:00 UTC.
Tess: Action items: 1) Arjun - publish manifest skeleton + TF outputs to 1Password by EOD. 2) Maya - upload EULA/DPA redlines by tomorrow. 3) PartnerOps - confirm offerId + assets checksums (done). 4) Everyone - be ready for staging dry-run next Thu.
Arjun: Will post manifest and TF outputs in 1Password and link here.
Maya: Redlines uploading now, will ping when done.
PartnerOps: Confirmed all artifacts present. Opening a parallel ticket to verify public listing copy length limits for Azure marketplace.
Tess: Great. If anything blocks, tag @Tess. Dry-run scheduled Thu 09:00 PT. :rocket:
